author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be GTA 6 discourse that has everything to do but the actual mechanics and quality of the game. Woke and Anti-woke discussions have now targeted the largest gaming launch in history and the takes I've seen might be the dumbest I've seen in forever, how? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Is GTA 6 Woke?
